verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev automations are plain TypeScript code kept in your repo and edited in an IDE, so they can be versioned in git. A documented GitHub Action deploys them on push to main, preview branches exist, and prompt templates are versioned on each deploy. Review is only implied through normal code workflows, and no first-party rollback feature appears in the evidence. Missing for 10: documented deployment version history and one-click rollback to a prior deploy, explicit review/approval workflow for automation changes, independent corroboration of versioning and rollback.
